name: Unidentified junk droid
description: This monster droid was one of several repurposed battle droids that were built by the Mandalorian extremist organization, Death Watch to be used as target practice by their soldiers.

data.name: Unidentified junk droid
data.model: Cobbled together from an IG-100 MagnaGuard, a BX-series droid commando, a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid and a B1-series battle droid
